R360.note: supports() correctly narrowed to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken; no other observable change.

R361.note: RFC 4515-style escaping closes the injection; extra escaping of '/' is harmless over-escaping (round-trips to the same literal).

R362.note: extension allowlist and UUID renaming are the direct fix for unrestricted-type upload; renamed/returned filename change is stated openly and does not block legitimate uploads.

R368.note: allowlist dispatch to the two functions that already existed is the direct fix for arbitrary function-name dispatch; no legitimate use lost.

R371.note: replaces proc_open/grep with native file()+strpos() literal search, preserving matches/error semantics while eliminating the shell entirely.
